youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Designer Scott Butchard on Missing Mission Replay
socialHook: GTA 6 doesn't allow direct mission replay, but Scott Butchard says it would feel alien to the story.

sections.heading: Design Rationale
paragraphs: Gamespot's report of Scott Butchard's Kotaku interview reveals that Rockstar considered a mission replay feature early in GTA 6 development but ultimately decided against it. Butchard explained that adding replay options felt at odds with the story the team was trying to tell, as replaying missions diminished the impact of player choices and made the experience feel alien and disconnected from the narrative vision.

sections.heading: Player Workarounds and Impact
paragraphs: While GTA 6 does not offer a straightforward mission replay menu, players can reload earlier save files or use the in-game menu to retry, quit, or restart missions in progress. Since launch, GTA 6 has sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone, generating approximately $4 billion in day-one revenue and contributing to new PlayStation and Xbox hardware sales. Rockstar has also addressed community feedback suggesting the game feels too easy, though the studio has not confirmed plans for a future mission replay update.
